caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular section of wallpaper design with a beige background. There are three birds with brown bodies and long, multicolored tails featuring hints of green, yellow, and red. The birds are perched on and around brown, twisting tree branches. The branches have clusters of large pink flowers with multiple layers of petals and green leaves with blueish highlights. Among the flowers and branches, there are several round, brown fruits with visible seeds. Small, scattered pink blossoms and individual green and blue leaves fill the spaces between the larger elements. At the bottom of the design, there is a pencil drawing of an ornamental fringe with hanging beads or tassels, detailed but uncolored. The composition repeats the pattern of birds, branches, flowers, and fruit in a visually balanced manner across the wallpaper section.
title: Curtain Drapery
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
